experiments.scope: Constructibility of the variant dense parts across all eight pattern branches (patterns 0..3: the four row-18/19 patterns with E16[23] = 0; patterns 4..7: the four R16x patterns with E16[23] = 1) and detection by the counted program (proof.md Sections 4.3, 7 and 13.2): supports H2 by verifying on organizer-seeded trials that all eight pattern branches reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions at commensurate rates (while the quantitative q3 SMC check runs in a0-online-r37), and H4 through Step-1 completion cost. experiments/lowm.py rebuilds S, L* and the 222 embedded classes from their descriptors; trials 0..127 each use class (7 t mod 222) (128 distinct classes), choose from SHAKE-256 of the seed a variant a0, impose pattern t mod 8 (0..3: E16[23] = 0, l in the 28 that hold row 16; 4..7: R16x, E16[23] = 1, any l; proof.md 7.4c, 7.6), and build a 37-step semi-free-start collision whose second-block state uses the variant (rows 16..21 by proposals with each row's fixed x-bits of E imposed, restarting after 2^11 proposals; row 22 by W22 proposals with W7 in F7 and W6 in F6; rows 22..36 with the variant's W8; W0..W5 by inverse expansion; CV1 by inverting steps 7..0). A trial returns CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' (96 bytes each) iff the Step-2 equations of (CV1, a0) give W0..W13 of both members, the two 37-step outputs match, M1 != M1', every cell of rows -4..36 (W6/W7 XOR cells excepted) and printed two-bit condition of rows 8..36 holds, a0 is in G and its class, and W8 differs from the published one. For trials 0..15, CV1 is fed to the counted online program restricted to the class of a0, which must find the constructed pair (detected_by_counted_program). Trials 128..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: about 128 (a trial can fail only by exhausting its proposal budget; on seed0..seed127, 124/128 succeed: 63/64 on patterns 0..3 and 61/64 on R16x patterns 4..7). Full collisions of the complete target: 0 (these are semi-free-start collisions from CV1, not from the IV; anyone can verify them offline with the 37-step compression). This tests that A0-variants of S (proof.md Lemmas 4.2, 4.3) are valid dense parts that reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions through every cell of rows 16..36 with their own W8 (Lemma 7.1), for each of the four accepted value patterns of rows 18 and 19 and each of the four R16x patterns of rows 16..19, and that the counted program of this filing finds the constructed pair. Observations: class_index, variant_index, l, pattern, checks_passed, restarts, proposals_row16, proposals_tail, detected_by_counted_program = 1 and counted_ops for trials 0..15.

experiments.scope: Functional exactness for H5, Lemmas 6.2, 8.1 and 8.2, an unconditional small-sample test of H1, and an organizer-seeded reduced-scale SMC consistency check of q3 for H2 (proof.md Sections 6..9, 12, 13.2). Each active trial (0..7) runs the counted online program (Section 8.2) on seed-drawn first blocks (two SHAKE-256 words per block; real 37-step compressions) with all 222 classes until a block has a passing class (at most 64 blocks), restricted to the first three passing classes: the W7 class test of all 222 classes, the W6 programs, scan, cube expansion, packed addresses, two-table probe, exact row-16 test, and rows 17..36; it then draws 64 unconditional first blocks and runs the bit-sliced W7 class test of all 222 classes on each (512 blocks per request), checking every lane against scalar F7 and recording uncond_first_blocks and uncond_class_passes against the H1 expectation 64 * 222 * p7 = 225.47 per trial (1,803.75 per request); finally, it runs an organizer-seeded reduced-scale importance-weighted SMC replicate of q3 (q3_smc_check, NP = 32 particles, exact stage-16 weight 2^-16, exact importance weights on stages 17..22 and uniform variant tail 23..36 over all 782,800 variants, recording q3_log2_est, q3_full_passes and q3_r16x_passes). Every lane of the class-test and pass planes is checked against scalar F7/F6, good pairs against brute force over all variants of processed classes, u against W0 + s0(W1), the table and exact row-16 tests against row 16 (every survivor lane and every 16th lane, all 32 l), and up to 12 good pairs against every cell of rows -4..15 for all 32 l in L*. Returns the 128-byte M0||M1 and M0||M1' (l = 13) of the first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 (rows 16..36 are not expected to hold on random first blocks). Mismatches of every kind: 0. Unconditional sample (H1): uncond_first_blocks = 64 per active trial (512 total across trials 0..7), expected uncond_class_passes = 225.47 per trial (1,803.75 total; 1,857 observed on seed0..seed7). Organizer-seeded reduced-scale q3 SMC check (H2): 8 independent holdout-seeded replicates (NP = 32, MT = 48) with linear-mean log2 estimate consistent with q3_used = 2^-71.47 (on seed0..seed7: 8-trial linear mean 2^-71.4771, 199 full row-23..36 passes across the 8 trials, 52 via R16x). Returned pairs: those trials whose first block with a passing class had a good pair. Observations: first_blocks, classes, uncond_first_blocks, uncond_class_passes, good_pairs, survivors, counted_ops, class_lane_mismatches, pass_lane_mismatches, goodset_mismatches, address_mismatches, row16_mismatches, cell_mismatches, q3_log2_est, q3_full_passes, q3_r16x_passes. Tests bit-sliced W7/W6, cube expansion (Lemma 8.2), packed address and row-16 stage (Lemma 6.2), 512-block unconditional W7 check for H1, and organizer-seeded reduced-scale q3 SMC consistency check for H2 (not a replacement for the 256-replicate NP = 8192 offline bounds, and does not test H1 at 2^55.8 scale or H3).
